title: Why Can't You NOT Think of a White Bear? 🐻‍❄️
description:
For five seconds, don't think of a white bear. Too late? Your brain hired a guard to make sure you don't, and every few seconds he checks: any bears? But to spot one, he has to picture one, so every check drags the bear right back. In a 1987 study, people who talked out loud for five minutes while trying NOT to think of a white bear rang a bell each time it came back: more than once a minute. It's probably also why your most embarrassing moment replays at 2 a.m. What helped them: picking one thing to think about on purpose instead, like a red car. Did you think of it? Yes or no?
